name: cv-pixel-checker
description: Measures every CV bullet against its rendered layout width in deterministic batches.

interface.shortDescription: Audit every CV line at exact rendered width.
interface.longDescription: Reads CV bullets from documents, measures the complete set in one MCP batch, preserves per-line layout profiles and formatting, and verifies that no submitted line was skipped.
defaultPrompt: Audit every bullet in my attached CV.
Rewrite these CV points to fit their exact widths.
Check this resume and report every line that overflows.
